newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end firmer after auction goes as expected.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end firmer after auction goes as expected.

text.p: * Key June 10-year JGBs closed slightly firmer after 2.4 percent 10-year bond auction went as expected. The auction produced lowest price of 100.80 and average price of 100.85. * Investors sidelined as they preferred buying new bond with price at par, one factor keeping June from rising sharply.
